title: ZILFIT Emotion Pipeline Session
description: Schema for emotion-driven CAD pipeline session payloads.

emotional_target.description: Target emotional profile (e.g., CALM, dynamic, FOCUS).

density_map.description: Density distribution map for the edition.

pressure_zones.description: Pressure zone definitions (e.g., heel, arch, forefoot).

geometry_hints.description: Geometry hints for CAD generation (wall thickness, cell size, etc.).

cad_directives.description: Directives passed to the CAD runtime.

simulation_profile.description: Simulation profile: load cases, constraints, material params.

warnings.description: List of warning strings generated during the session.

raw_payload_json.description: Full serialized payload as JSON string.
